claims: Denmark is a Nordic country.
Denmark is the southernmost Scandinavian nation.
Denmark comprises the Jutland peninsula and 406 islands.
Denmark is a constitutional monarchy.
Denmark includes the autonomous territories of Greenland and the Faroe Islands.
Copenhagen is the capital city of Denmark.
Denmark is a member of the EU.
Denmark is a member of NATO.
Denmark is located in Northern Europe.
Denmark borders Germany to the south.
Denmark has maritime borders with Sweden and Norway.
Denmark's government is a constitutional monarchy with a parliamentary system.
Denmark ranks fourth in the EU in terms of GDP per capita.
The population of metropolitan Denmark is approximately 5.9 million.
Denmark's languages include Danish with minority recognition of German and Faroese/Greenlandic in autonomous regions.
Copenhagen is located on the island of Zealand.
Aarhus is a major urban center on the Jutland peninsula.
Odense is the birthplace of author Hans Christian Andersen.
Denmark's landscape is generally flat.
Denmark's landscape is characterized by agricultural land and sandy coastlines.
Denmark has been a member of the EU since 1972
